thm:r71-envelope.proof: Source stochastic power-sector bound + pigeonhole approximation for necessity; denominator-multiple polygon realization for sufficiency. Constants uniform in every nonreal phase and positive noise.

lem:r71-cf.proof: Classical continued-fraction determinant, complete quotient and integral convergent basis. The best-second-kind inequality and irrationality-exponent formula are proved, not attributed as new arithmetic.

thm:r71-exponents.proof: Eventual approximation bounds give global lower/upper slopes. Consecutive-convergent crossover scales give the matching upper slope and very good denominators give the lower slope. Infinite exponent treated separately.

thm:r71-cubic-rigidity.proof: Bounded convergent ratios retain the prior cubic law. Unbounded ratios provide opposite normalized subsequences; no finite continued-fraction scan certifies a global property.

cor:r71-mixtures.proof: Individual nonreal modes give lower bounds; counted block mixtures and the live zero-output state give upper bounds. Only finite-max limsup is interchanged, never liminf.
